liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Carried Away** (1 review): The reviewer singles out this song as a standout performance of the night [5]
- **Thin Line** (1 review): This track is identified by the reviewer as one of the show's standouts [5]
- **War Begun** (1 review): The source lists this song among the standout performances of the evening [5]
- **Dondante** (1 review): The source highlights the epic, stretched-out performance of this specific track [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **At Dawn**: back after 27 archived shows (799 days) [7]
- **Aluminum Park**: back after 42 archived shows (874 days) [7]
- **Heartbreakin Man**: back after 21 archived shows (580 days) [7]
- **Evelyn Is Not Real**: back after 30 archived shows (804 days) [7]
- **Hopefully**: back after 26 archived shows (771 days) [7]
- **Thin Line**: back after 25 archived shows (770 days) [7]
- **Tonight I'll Be Staying Here With You**: back after 249 archived shows (4583 days); rare: 3 archived performances [7]
- **Knot Comes Loose**: back after 32 archived shows (806 days) [7]

## The recordings

- **mmj2017-12-29.mk41v.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 24 songs; 147 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: The reviewer states the Hyper mics were superior to the U-89i mics for this distance [6]
- **mmj2017-12-29.ck930.flac24**: source not stated; 25 songs; 147 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: The reviewer notes the recording contains juicy satanic messages when played backwards [4]
- **mmj2017-12-29.ck930.flac16**: source not stated; 25 songs; 147 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- The band performed outdoors at Red Rocks the previous year, according to the reviewer [6]
- The setlist includes a Bob Dylan cover and a David Bowie cover [2]
- The band opened their set with a song titled The Revolution [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2017-12-29.mk41v.flac16**: taped by Chris King; source: Schoeps mk41v (din) > kcy > aki > M222 > NT222 > Sonosax SX-R4+ (24/96) [1]
- **mmj2017-12-29.ck930.flac24**: taped by Mike B; transferred by Mike B; source: Beyerdynamic CK930 > Naiant IPA > Sound Devices MixPre-6 (@ 24/48) [3]
- **mmj2017-12-29.ck930.flac16**: taped by Mike B; transferred by Mike B; source: Beyerdynamic CK930 > Naiant IPA > Sound Devices MixPre-6 (@ 24/48) [2]
